# Module `highlight`

What the CSS Custom Highlight API has registered (CSS.highlights), for the painter: the objects are native/js/odin/web_highlight.js,
which sends the whole registry again after a change, in a microtask (src/page/highlights.odin).

Exposed to: Window. Source: `api/highlight.widl`.

Odin: `import "wren:highlight"`.

## Functions

```
void Highlights_clear()
```

The registry starts over, empty.

Host: `Highlights_clear :: proc(c: ^Call)`

### `Highlights_add`

```
void Highlights_add(string name, i32 priority)
```

A registered highlight, the one the next Highlights_addRange calls fill.

Host: `Highlights_add :: proc(c: ^Call, name: string, priority: i32)`

### `Highlights_addRange`

```
void Highlights_addRange(Node start, u32 start_offset, Node end, u32 end_offset)
```
